head: 0e2308fc055072d74ac90ddabfb1be282b0140f0
method: All angles inline in reviewer context; candidates frozen before parent self-review record was read; pooled and deduplicated, no verification.

findings.summary: [P2] Preserve the upstream empty-result status announcement.
findings.failure_scenario: A screen-reader user enters a query with no matches while focus remains in the combobox. The custom Empty renderer replaces upstream role=status with an ordinary paragraph, so the no-match message is not announced.
findings.resolution: Restore role=status; browser regression asserts the live status element. No physical screen-reader conformance claim.

findings.summary: [P3] Move released-version checks into a Make-owned target.
findings.failure_scenario: Release builds maintain their own check sequence, which can drift from local verification and violates .agents/rules/ci.md: Make recipes own executable check commands. CI should call those same targets.
findings.resolution: Latest and release matrix builds both call make site-ci; the target passed at a fixture prerelease prefix.

outcome: Two findings addressed; no P0/P1 identified. Small fixes, no second independent review.
